name: Decorated Marzipan and Fondant Fruitcake
subtitle: A festive fruitcake finished with colored fondant and sugared almond decorations.
description: Cover a fruitcake with apricot jam, marzipan, and white fondant, then add simple colored decorations and sugared almonds.

ingredients.item: icing sugar plus extra for dusting

instructions.text: Place the fruitcake on a clean work surface and prepare it for covering.
Dust the surface with icing sugar. Knead the marzipan until pliable, then roll it into a thick sheet large enough to cover the cake.
Warm or stir the apricot jam until smooth, then brush it over the cake. Lay the marzipan over the cake and smooth it into place.
Roll the white fondant icing on icing sugar until smooth and thick enough to cover the cake. Drape it over the marzipan and smooth the surface and sides.
Tint portions of the fondant blue and green with the coloring gels. Roll and cut the colored and remaining white fondant into simple decorations.
Attach the decorations to the cake with a small amount of softened fondant or jam, then arrange the colored sugared almonds over the surface.
Leave the decorated cake undisturbed until the covering is set before slicing and serving.
